s1.quote: Eel Garden … Eel Garden 10 to 40+ meters Moderate to strong Advanced

s2.quote: Eel Garden … The wall is located on the westernmost edge of the island, and it drops down to approximately 40 meters. It ends with a sandy channel home to a large colony of dancing garden eels.

highlights.text: Garden eel colony in sandy channel
Large schools of fish in the passing current

summary.text: A wall on Menjangan's western tip that drops to about 40 m into a sandy channel with garden eels. Passing current brings fish schools but makes it one of the trickier Menjangan dives, rated advanced.

s1.quote: you enter Blackforest from it’s deeper part. … black tip reef sharks as well as stingrays. The dive site is accessible to all certified divers … Maximum depth: 20 meters

s2.quote: Of all the sites in Una-Una, Black Forest is unique. It is all about the different shapes and colors of hard corals.

summary.text: A signature Una Una site known for strange hard-coral formations, starting over a shallow meadow of lettuce corals and reaching about 20 m. Blacktip reef sharks and stingrays patrol it, and any certified diver can do it.

s1.quote: Hong Kong is the favorite hangout for turtles around Una Una … With a maximum depth of 20 meters
The Kingstonwall site offers you the opportunity to see bigger fish swimming around, like eagle rays, Napoleon wrasses or turtles. … Maximum depth: 30+ meters

highlights.text: Small caves and crevices in the wall

s1.quote: Named after Una Una’s south cape ‘Apollo’, this is the spot were a school of hundreds (sometimes thousand plus) of barracuda live. … Maximum depth: 40 meters

s2.quote: Apollo: This is a reef which starts on about 22m depth and gently slopes down to 45m and more.

summary.text: A deep sloping reef off Una Una's south cape, starting around 22 m and running to 40-45 m. The draw is a huge school of barracuda, sometimes over a thousand, that circles curiously around divers.

s1.quote: Greta’s … This dive site is on the edge of the wall and the sloping bottom. A perfect spot for a confetti of colorful fish on plenty of intact soft corals. … Maximum depth: 30+ meters

s2.quote: Greta Place was a nice, serene dive site with lots of large hard and soft corals.

highlights.text: Intact soft corals and colourful reef fish

summary.text: A calm Una Una dive where the wall meets the sloping bottom, down to 30 m or more. Large hard and soft corals support plenty of colourful reef fish, and the neighbouring wall sometimes brings bigger visitors.

s1.quote: Artemis … The furthest dive site is maybe the most colorful one. From a very deep drop (we never saw the end) … Maximum depth: 40 meters Partially wall, partially coral garden

highlights.text: Large coral formations; octopus, eagle ray

s1.quote: Jungle … This unique positioning makes this dive site a must-see for beginning and experienced divers. Maximum depth: 30 meters, but mostly shallower than 18

highlights.text: Dense corals; wall running around north side
